scenario: You are working at the city zoo. Your supervisor is explaining how to help visitors at the entrance. Listen to the supervisor and repeat what the supervisor says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: Your job today is helping at the entrance.
Visitors can pick up a free map at the gate.
Feeding the animals is not allowed anywhere in the park.
If a child gets lost, bring them to the information booth.
The penguin show takes place twice a day near the main lake.
When it gets very hot, remind families that there are water stations along every path.
